= nested-code-links(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Link tests
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-02

== Name
nested-code-links - nested code links remain valid roff

== Synopsis
*nested-code-links*

== Description

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
N01 https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner] after].
N02 https://outer.example[mailto:first@example.org[First]mailto:second@example.org[Second]].
N03 *Before https://outer.example[Before *bold mailto:test@example.org[Inner] tail* after] end*.
N04 https://outer.example[Before footnote:n[Note with https://note.example[Note].] after].
N05 https://outer.example[Before ((Term)) and (((Hidden))) after].
N06 ((Before mailto:index@example.org[Indexed] after)).
N07 https://example.org[Label]anchor:after-link[].
N08 https://example.org[Label]pass:[&amp;]suffix.
N09 *Before https://example.org[Multiline]
  after*.
N10 https://outer.example[Before image:picture.svg[Picture,link=https://image.example] after].
----

See <<after-link,After link>>.
